name: @enhancely/adapter-lambda-edge
description: CloudFront Lambda@Edge origin-request injector with a cache-cap-only origin-response companion

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/origin-request-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/origin-request.js "--external:@aws-sdk/*" && esbuild src/companion.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/companion.js "--external:@aws-sdk/*"
scripts.package: pnpm --filter @enhancely/injector-core build && pnpm run build && rm -f dist/connector-config.json && { cp connector-config.json dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; } && cd dist && rm -rf lambda-origin-request.zip lambda-companion.zip .pkg && mkdir -p .pkg && cp origin-request.js .pkg/index.js && { cp connector-config.json .pkg/ 2>/dev/null || true; } && ( cd .pkg && zip -q -X ../lambda-origin-request.zip index.js && { zip -q ../lambda-origin-request.zip connector-config.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; } ) && rm -rf .pkg && mkdir -p .pkg && cp companion.js .pkg/index.js && { cp connector-config.json .pkg/ 2>/dev/null || true; } && ( cd .pkg && zip -q -X ../lambda-companion.zip index.js && { zip -q ../lambda-companion.zip connector-config.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; } ) && rm -rf .pkg && echo "dist/lambda-origin-request.zip (origin-request) + dist/lambda-companion.zip (companion) ready"
